description.fun: Whismur normally murmurs so quietly you can barely hear it, but when it's startled it lets out a 100-decibel cry as loud as a jet taking off, then frightens itself into crying even louder until it falls asleep exhausted. Because it breathes through its ears, it can keep going, but it stops if its ear flaps are shut. Its name blends whisper and murmur.
description.guide: A small Normal-type Pokémon with ear flaps covering its ear canals. It usually speaks very quietly but cries extremely loudly when frightened. It evolves into Loudred at level 20 and Exploud at level 40.
description.tagline: A whispering bunny whose scream rivals a jet engine

description.fun: Loudred is a walking boombox: it breathes in, then blasts out a shout with its powerful stomach muscles, using its round ears as loudspeakers and stomping to build up power. Its voice can tip over trucks and splinter wooden houses, though afterwards it's left temporarily deaf. It and Whismur were designed by Takao Unno.
description.guide: A Normal-type Pokémon, the middle stage of the Whismur line, resembling a boombox with loudspeaker ears. Its shouts are powerful enough to knock over trucks. It evolves into Exploud at level 40.
description.tagline: A living boombox whose shout can flip a truck

description.fun: Exploud is a living pipe organ: it draws air in through the tubes all over its body to power its bellows, which can set off earthquakes and carry more than ten kilometres. It only raises its voice in battle, though, and otherwise speaks in whistle-like sounds. Long ago, distant cities used Exploud to send messages to one another.
description.guide: A Normal-type Pokémon, the final form of Whismur, covered in tube-like vents that amplify its voice. Its bellowing can be heard from far away and can cause tremors. It can learn more sound-based moves than any other Pokémon.
description.tagline: A pipe-organ beast whose bellow can trigger earthquakes
